name: edgepay-cf
description: EdgePay — self-hosted payment gateway rebuilt on HonoJS + Cloudflare Workers edge runtime

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run db:migrations:apply:dev && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run db:migrations:apply:staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:apply:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:apply:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.staging.jsonc

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign mobile-companion JWTs. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` (minimum 32 characters) and paste the result.

APP_KEY.description: HMAC key for signing. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32` and paste the result.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: AES-256-GCM key that encrypts gateway credentials and PII at rest. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32` and paste the result. **Store it safely — losing it makes stored credentials unrecoverable.**
